comments.text: Would ryzen 5900x and a 3070ti be good for 4k gaming im asking cuz im kinda new to the PC building
comments.author: @joelmorgan3033

comments.text:
@joelmorgan3033  yes it would. A 3070 vs 3070ti is only a very slight upgrade. The RTX 3070 vs the RTX 3080 / 3080Ti is where the next big jump is.
If you want to have a GPU to last you for 4K gaming for at least a few years. Id recommend the 3080 or 3080ti preferably the 12GB version or at least the 10GB VRAM version 3080's. 
New games with more textures and background details will require more VRAM to run those settings, not just CPU & GPU power. 
Since this is your first higher end build it sounds like, and considering GPU prices. I would get the 3070 as you can get them from Newegg for closer to $700-800 vs the RTX 3080 minimum of 1K$ if you can find that particular card model in stock.
Basically if you have the extra money for the 3080 chippped GPUs get that. Otherwise a 3070 with that nice Ryzen CPU will perform awesome at 4K. Not all games on Ultra maybe but close to it..
comments.author: @mxracingunlimitedltd7784

comments.text:
Also VR headset gaming in general requires more VRAM usage. So a lot of people will get either the 12GB 3080ti if they want to spend the money for the best GPU out right now or going for the newer 12GB VRAM version of the RTX 3060. 
But the 3060 is too expensive in my opinion and id want at least the 3060ti, but at that point a 3070 is the way to go or if you can get lucky and grab the 3070ti for only alittle more money than you can jump on that instead.
But to answer your question, yes it will game great and be on par or better than an Xbox series X. I have both. 
My cpu setup is very similar to yours but i just went with the cheaper Ryzen 5 5600x CPU and its been super impressive..!!
